provenance: Engineering instruction-energy estimates; bare Snitch 25 kGE and FPU 142 kGE anchored to Spatz Fig. 9, https://arxiv.org/pdf/2309.10137v2. Assume a separate scalar FPU per core, including vector-attached cores.
background_assumption: Ungated residual clock power while the modeled core exists. Instruction and stall energy are additional; idle is not power-off.
